name: english-lms
description: Self-hosted English LMS with 13 public learning modules and a PostgreSQL bank of 1305 MCQs.

scripts.check: node --check src/server.js && node --check src/routes/site.js && node --check src/routes/admin.js && node --check src/services/assessment.js
scripts.db:seed:all: npm run db:seed && npm run db:seed:extra && npm run db:seed:final
scripts.qa:all: python3 scripts/qa_bank.py && python3 scripts/qa_expanded.py && python3 scripts/qa_templates.py
